metadata.missionTarget: Lunar South Polar Permanently Shadowed Regions
metadata.psrSource: NASA LOLA South Pole Permanently Shadowed Regions (LROC)

confidenceBudget.model_name: Multi-Sensor Radar Agreement & Anomaly SNR Budget
confidenceBudget.assumptions: Confidence score is a composite metric derived from radar corroboration (both Pv and CPR positive anomaly) and spatial SNR.

volumeModel.description: Indicative Subsurface Volume Estimate derived from radar anomalous area and assumed penetration depth.

pixelAnomalyScore.definition: Min-max normalized (0-1) per-pixel Isolation Forest anomaly score. Higher = more anomalous relative to this window, not a calibrated ice probability.
pixelAnomalyScore.note: Unlike mlAnomalyScore (Track J-v1, 336 PSRs as samples with Pv-derived aggregate features), this run uses independent real per-pixel radar bands as features -- no circularity caveat applies. The PSR-interior vs. surroundings separation is real but modest, not a dramatic signal.

physicsEvidenceScore.serdExclusionReason: SERD delta is negative for this candidate (lower inside PSR) while Pv/CPR/T-Ratio are positive -- inconsistent directionality, reported but not summed into the score.
physicsEvidenceScore.weighting: Unweighted mean (1/3 each) of min-max normalized deltas across the 7-candidate shortlist. Documented default, not a literature-calibrated weighting.
physicsEvidenceScore.notWhat: NOT a probability of ice. A relative ranking within PRISM's own 7-candidate shortlist only -- not validated against any independent ice-confirmed site.

mlAnomalyScore.circularityWarning: All 4 features are derived from the same Y4R Pv computation that already produced this candidate's shortlist ranking. This is NOT an independent evidence source -- it cannot be claimed to independently validate the candidate's Pv-based selection.

candidateSpecific.calibrationApplied: XML bias_real/bias_imag subtraction only (per-polarization). No gain-imbalance or phase-orthogonality correction applied.
candidateSpecific.note: Physics evidence score and ML anomaly score above were NOT recomputed to include this DOP value.

pipelineValidationNonCandidate.status: NON-CANDIDATE VALIDATION -- different (2025-10-25) acquisition, does not cover this candidate

terrain.source: PRISM/outputs/objective2/SP_840980_0797630_terrain_stats.json (Track G, real NASA LOLA 20m/px DEM, GDAL /vsicurl/ windowed remote read)

slope.thresholdCaveat: Safe(<10)/caution(10-20)/hazard(>=20 deg) thresholds carried over verbatim from an earlier notebook, author-flagged as 'crude' -- NOT independently validated against any lander/rover specification.

roughnessTri.method: Riley, Degloria & Elliot (1999) Terrain Ruggedness Index

terrain.interpretation: This is a SAFETY/HAZARD profile, not ice evidence. It is deliberately NOT combined into the physics evidence score. Reported honestly even though unfavorable: 78.6% of the PSR interior itself exceeds the (unvalidated) 20-degree hazard threshold, versus 10.5% of the surrounding approach terrain. A high radar ice-evidence score does not imply an easy landing site.
terrain.notIncluded: Optical (OHRC) boulder/hazard detection is separate, unfinished work (Member 3 / Objective 2 CV pipeline) -- not part of this terrain dataset.
